title: Never a lesson, and picking up small gigs
summary: He never had a lesson on anything, took small gigs while learning, and came to the trombone more or less by coincidence.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: So you didn't go and study or anything.
